subject.title: [Feature]: UI 用量显示为 0，实际在消耗 token

question: Should OpenClaw add Qwen/DashScope account-usage support in the Qwen plugin now, and which Alibaba usage endpoint and semantics should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior depends on maintainer acceptance of credential routing and whether the UI should show resettable quota windows, balance/spend summaries, or separate behavior per Qwen plan type.

options.title: Define Qwen Usage Hooks
options.body: Add Qwen-owned usage auth and snapshot hooks after confirming the DashScope endpoint, credential source, and quota/balance normalization.

options.title: Document Unsupported Usage
options.body: Keep per-turn token accounting only and document that Qwen/DashScope account usage is not shown until vendor proof is available.

options.title: Defer To Provider Package
options.body: Leave this for an external or ClawHub Qwen/Alibaba plugin if maintainers do not want bundled Alibaba account-usage ownership.

recommendation.title: Define Qwen Usage Hooks
recommendation.body: Add Qwen-owned usage auth and snapshot hooks after confirming the DashScope endpoint, credential source, and quota/balance normalization.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest shared owner across the Qwen provider and the generic provider-billing contract.
